'''Siavash Mirshams Shahshahani''' ({{langx|fa|سیاوش میرشمس شهشهانی}}; born May 31, 1942) is an Iranian mathematician. He is a professor of mathematics and head of Mathematical Sciences Department at [[Sharif University of Technology]].  He headed up the IRNIC registry for the [[.ir]] ccTLD until his retirement from that position in late 2008.  He has also served as a director of [[APTLD]] (the Asia Pacific Top Level Domain Association) between 2007 and his retirement from that position in February 2009.

==Education==
Shahshahani completed his PhD under the supervision of [[Stephen Smale]] at the [[University of California at Berkeley]] in 1969. He has since devoted a substantial part of his career to mathematical education.
